name: Probe: why MakePeaceWith did nothing in court-arbitration-05. In gameplay (GameCore_Tuner) on the 15 km Japan map with the arbitration mod: the R01 war (Ouchi-Otomo, turn 1) and three fresh forced wars; MakePeaceWith(b), MakePeaceWith(b, true) and from both sides on turns 1, 2, 11 and 12, with CanMakePeaceWith, GetAtWarChangeTurn, IsAtWarWith after each call, and DIPLOMACY_WAR_MIN_TURNS / DIPLOMACY_PEACE_MIN_TURNS / GetMinPeaceDuration. Every read returns a value; nothing errors

steps.code: local function q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end; local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() or '','^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; local P={R01={'OUCHI','OTOMO'},F1={'CHOSOKABE','AINU'},F2={'RYUKYU','DATE'},F3={'SHIMAZU','ASHINA'}}; local ORDER={'R01','F1','F2','F3'}; local function D(n) return Players[id[n]]:GetDiplomacy() end; local function state(k) local a,b=P[k][1],P[k][2]; return k..'{war='..q(function() return D(a):IsAtWarWith(id[b]) end)..' can='..q(function() return D(a):CanMakePeaceWith(id[b]) end)..'/'..q(function() return D(b):CanMakePeaceWith(id[a]) end)..' changed='..q(function() return D(a):GetAtWarChangeTurn(id[b]) end)..'}' end; local function states() local s={} for _,k in ipairs(ORDER) do s[#s+1]=state(k) end return table.concat(s,' ') end; local function Try(k,from,withTrue) local a,b=P[k][1],P[k][2]; if from=='b' then a,b=b,a end; local r=q(function() if withTrue then D(a):MakePeaceWith(id[b],true) else D(a):MakePeaceWith(id[b]) end return 'called' end); return k..' '..a..':MakePeaceWith('..b..(withTrue and ',true' or '')..') '..r..' war_after='..q(function() return D(P[k][1]):IsAtWarWith(id[P[k][2]]) end) end; local out={'turn='..(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1)..' engine='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()}; local function add(s) out[#out+1]=s end; add('params WAR_MIN='..q(function() return GameInfo.GlobalParameters['DIPLOMACY_WAR_MIN_TURNS'].Value end)..' PEACE_MIN='..q(function() return GameInfo.GlobalParameters['DIPLOMACY_PEACE_MIN_TURNS'].Value end)..' GetMinPeaceDuration='..q(function() return Game.GetGameDiplomacy():GetMinPeaceDuration() end)); for _,k in ipairs({'F1','F2','F3'}) do add(k..' DeclareWarOn '..q(function() D(P[k][1]):DeclareWarOn(id[P[k][2]],WarTypes.FORMAL_WAR,true) return 'called' end)) end; add('before '..states()); add(Try('F1','a',false)); add(Try('F2','a',true)); add(Try('F3','b',false)); add(Try('F3','a',false)); add(Try('R01','a',false)); add(Try('R01','b',false)); add(Try('R01','a',true)); add(Try('R01','b',true)); add('after '..states()); for _,line in ipairs(out) do print('[JAC_PEACE_PROBE] '..line) end; return table.concat(out,' | ')
